comment: Outcome assertions for conformance/h3.json — the ext-h3 extension's conformance is the derivation, not pixels: read the blocks, derive the core transform from the H3 fields, check that the derivation and the core transform the producer wrote both equal the expected values (spec/extensions/h3.md, 'Deriving the core transform'). No reference carries an H3 library, so cell_centres holds cellToLatLng of every cell the world names, [lat, lng] in degrees, as data; a runner with an H3 library SHOULD verify them. Assertion kinds: frame {cell, resolution, body} (what the environment declares); edge_length {resolution, metres, tolerance} (the unit table, H3 4's getHexagonEdgeLengthAvgM); placed {entity, position, rotation_degrees, scale, tolerance} (the entity's derived transform and its core transform are both within tolerance of these: metres, degrees, factors).
